title: Static Files per Tenant: Serve Each Tenant's Own Files | Orchard Core
description:
A tenant that needs its own robots.txt, favicon or logo has no place for it in the shared wwwroot folder of the application.

The Static File Provider feature gives each tenant a wwwroot folder of its own, in its site folder, and serves the files under the tenant's domain and URL prefix. The video enables the feature, serves a different robots.txt for each of two tenants, and reads the code behind it.

In this video:
• Why a file provider per tenant
• Enable the feature in the admin, or in a recipe
• Add files to the wwwroot folder of a tenant
• Request the files of two tenants
• How the provider is registered and serves the files
• Which file is served first, the SEO module and tenant removal
